models_evaluated: machine learning and informatics algorithm identifying medically complex inpatients with non-English language preference

links.outcome: Time from study entry to first in-person interpreter visit, intervention vs control
links.effect: Time to receiving interpreter did not differ between groups (HR 1.02, 95% CI 0.81-1.29, p=0.87); the abstract reports an OR and CI close to >1 for receiving an interpreter.
links.quote: Time to receiving interpreter did not differ between groups (HR = 1.02, 95% C.I. (0.81, 1.29), p = 0.87).

unlisted_practices: Language services outreach to bedside nurses via secure chat, triggered by an AI-generated list, to prompt in-person interpreter use

screen.reason: Evaluates the clinical deployment and workflow integration of an AI/ML algorithm used to identify complex NELP patients to trigger language service outreach via a stepped-wedge cluster randomized trial.

primary.practice: AI-driven targeted workflow outreach to bedside staff
